claims.evidence: No nameplate, stamped rating, or model tag visible in any photo; power rating cannot be read from the housing alone.
Photos 0-2 show a solid cast/machined housing consistent with a cast-body gear unit.
No import paperwork, shipping label, or country-of-origin marking visible.
No video of the unit running, no power source or load shown connected.
Noise cannot be assessed from still photos; requires an audio/video clip of operation.
This is automotive terminology misapplied to a gearbox; no hour-meter or usage log is visible, and the phrasing itself is a generic-sounding claim.
No close-up of factory seals, paint-over-bolts, or tamper marks on the housing flange bolts is shown.

risks.risk: Unknown power/torque rating and gear ratio
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the manufacturer nameplate or stamped ID on the housing showing model, ratio, and HP rating.
risks.if_unproven: price as a generic unrated unit at the lowest end of its size class

risks.risk: Internal gear and bearing condition (wear, pitting, play)
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit running under load with audible sound, plus input/output shaft rotated by hand showing no excess play.
Photo of input and output shaft diameters and lengths measured with a tape or caliper, plus bolt-pattern dimensions on base plate.
risks.if_unproven: price as generic/unknown fitment, not guaranteed compatible with buyer's machine

risks.risk: Lubricant condition and seal integrity (leaks, water ingress)
risks.proof: Photo of oil fill/drain plug removed showing oil color/level, and close-up of shaft seals for cracking or leakage stains.
Close-up of flange bolts and casing seams showing intact factory paint or seal marks with no tool marks.

risks.risk: Import/history claim (Belgium, tokunbo) unverifiable, could be relabeled stock
risks.proof: Photo of any import tag, customs sticker, or original shipping carton with origin marking.
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-origin used unit, no premium for claimed import pedigree

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the nameplate or any stamped model/ratio/HP markings on the housing
Short video of the gearbox running (input turned or powered) with audible sound, showing shaft rotation and no knocking
Photo of shaft dimensions with a tape measure or caliper for both input and output ends
Photo of the oil fill plug removed showing lubricant color and level
Close-up of flange bolts and casing seams for tamper/seal evidence
Any import documentation, shipping label, or carton showing country of origin
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an unbranded industrial gear reducer, so it can be priced at worst case as an unrated, unverified-condition used unit; all of the seller's functional and provenance claims remain unverifiable remotely and do not raise the price until supported by nameplate, operation video, or seal evidence.
